verdict.rationale: Skyfire documents self-service onboarding (auto-created Buyer Agent, API keys generated in the dashboard with no partnership required) and a 'find-sellers' MCP tool plus a browsable Directory for programmatic discovery of seller services (skyfire-docs-1, skyfire-docs-11/12/13, skyfire-docs-15, skyfire-supp-9). However, access is self-service-credential-gated rather than keyless — a runtime probe shows the API rejects unauthenticated calls with NOT_AUTHORIZED (skyfire-probe-rt-1) — and the 'merchants' searchable are limited to sellers that have been approved onto Skyfire's own service directory (skyfire-docs-3/14), not an open web of arbitrary merchants. Missing for 10: evidence of true keyless discovery, evidence of discovery breadth across independent/third-party merchants outside Skyfire's approval-gated seller directory, and independent (non-vendor) corroboration.
